description: This file defines a React component 'RecommendationGrid' that fetches and displays a grid of recommended roles based on user persona and filters. It manages state for roles, loading, errors, and expanded role cards, and handles filtering, data fetching, and user interactions.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a trimmed string, converting null or undefined to an empty string.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an input to an array of trimmed strings, filtering out falsy values.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses role salary information into minimum and maximum values in Lakhs, handling various data formats.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the role title from a role object.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Checks if a role object matches the provided filters including industry, skills, salary range, and title.
